{{Wireless adapter |brand=Atheros |model=AR5B22 |revision=-SB |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=02/22/2012 |manuf_country= |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |if=Mini PCIe (half) |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=PPD-AR5B22SB |ic_id=4104A-AR5B22SB |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR9463 |flags=bluetooth |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This is a single-band version of the [[Atheros AR5B22|WB222]].
"WB222", "250-02062-060", and "©2010,2011 Atheros" is silkscreened on the front of the module in the FCC photos. The '''Atheros''' logo is emblazoned on the back.
